memories.assetName: Asset P-104 — Hazira-Vijaipur Northern Feed Corridor
memories.sanitizedSummary: Repair REP-104, on 20 August 2023, reinforced circumferential weld with welded split sleeve following micro-fissure detection at asset P-104.
memories.actionsTaken: Welded Type-B pressure-containing sleeve installed and radiographed.

memories.assetName: Asset P-104 — Hazira-Vijaipur Northern Feed Corridor
memories.sanitizedSummary: Inspection INS-178, on 14 February 2023, flagged cathodic protection disbondment and early corrosion initiation at asset P-104 invert.

memories.assetName: GAIL Hazira-Vijaipur-Jagdishpur (HVJ) Gas Trunk (Hazira to Vijaipur)
memories.sanitizedSummary: Inspection INS-GAIL-202 confirmed superficial soil-induced oxidation near Ankleshwar river crossing at asset IND-GAS-HVJ-001. Monitored; wall loss within tolerance.
memories.actionsTaken: Erosion control rip-rap boulders placed along bank; continuous cathodic logging enabled.
memories.sourceReference: GAIL SCADA & River Crossing Integrity Audit #202

memories.assetName: GAIL Hazira-Vijaipur-Jagdishpur (HVJ) Gas Trunk (Hazira to Vijaipur)
memories.sanitizedSummary: Repair REP-GAIL-044 replaced high-pressure isolation valve actuator and calibrated telemetry at Vadodara Compressor Station for asset IND-GAS-HVJ-001.
memories.actionsTaken: Class 600 emergency shut-down ball valve rebuilt with hydrogen-rated seals.

memories.sanitizedSummary: Inspection INS-IOCL-341 detected mechanical dent and surface gouge caused by unauthorized farm trenching near Viramgam at asset IND-OIL-SMPL-005. Type-A structural sleeve fitted.
memories.actionsTaken: Reinforcing steel sleeve welded; pipeline ROW markers re-installed.
memories.sourceReference: IOCL Pipelines Division Line Patrol Incident Report #341

memories.assetName: Delhi Jal Board Sonia Vihar & Ring Road Bulk Water Transmission
memories.sanitizedSummary: Repair REP-DJB-088 sealed high-volume gasket flange leak and replaced corroded high-tensile bolts under Kashmere Gate Ring Road for asset IND-WTR-DJB-008.
memories.actionsTaken: EPDM drinking-water grade gasket installed; heavy zinc-plated fasteners torqued to spec.
memories.sourceReference: Delhi Jal Board Central Maintenance Division Work Ticket #088

memories.sanitizedSummary: Inspection INS-MNL-019 confirmed joint displacement and lead-wool packing washout due to heavy monsoon road subsidence near Mall Road bus stand for asset MNL-WTR-001.
memories.actionsTaken: Mechanical flexible joint clamp fitted; backfilled with crushed basalt scree.
memories.sourceReference: Jal Shakti Vibhag (Kullu Division) Monsoon Emergency Log #019
